actor.allowed: current owner of personal vault; non-guest or registered account

preconditions: valid session at admission and transaction execution
invariants: No blob, content version or sharing permission is added or removed.
Only the current owner may mutate lifecycle.
A stale new operation cannot change authoritative state.
State and audit receipt commit atomically.
One operation identity has at most one lifecycle effect.
No confirmed success before durable commit.

idempotency.fingerprint: SHA256(capability, version, id, expectedVersion, contractDigest, policyDigest)
idempotency.same_input: return original effect/audit with current resource projection

concurrency_semantics.linearization: transactional collection lock; compare version and authorize inside callback
concurrency_semantics.ABA: monotonic documentRevision included in version hash
concurrency_semantics.revocation: must be visible to session resolver before transaction callback; owner checked on locked collection

failure_semantics.retry: reuse original operationId and payload after uncertain outcome

recovery_semantics: Retry after missing response reads durable receipt and current state.

audit_requirements.durable: operation receipt in same collection transaction
audit_requirements.payload: opaque actor-bound auditRef, operation identity, versions, effect, contract/policy digests, timestamp
audit_requirements.denied: HTTP status/request log; no success receipt

privacy_requirements: No credentials, file content or file name in operation receipt.
No other owner data or receipts in denial.
Existing encrypted storage and account erasure policy apply; this pilot does not certify those policies.
interface_requirements: UI, Edge and Rahul submit the same input to POST /api/bestanden/actie.
Legacy owner weg/herstel translate to this gateway.
Rahul requires a server-held confirmed proposal.
Responses never confer authority on future requests.
Refresh, focus, online and new-tab reads converge to server state.

side_effects.delivery: pull on refresh/focus/online; no realtime push guarantee in v1

capabilities.intent: Move an owned file to trash without erasure.
capabilities.invalid_state_semantics: Already trashed with current version: successful no-op; no revision increment.

capabilities.intent: Restore a trashed owned file with all content versions intact.
capabilities.invalid_state_semantics: A new restore of an active file is 409 invalid_state; replay of a prior valid restore remains valid.
